providerDefault: OFF on Gemini 2.5 and Gemini 3 models
summary: Sets the probability at which Gemini blocks a response per harm category. A lower threshold blocks more, a higher one lets more through, so BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE is the strictest and OFF disables that category's filter.
combines: Thresholds, strictest to loosest: BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE, BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE, BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH, BLOCK_NONE, OFF.
Four categories are adjustable: harassment, hate speech, sexually explicit and dangerous content. Built-in protections such as child safety are not adjustable here.
Because current models already default to OFF, sending this can only make Lixpi stricter than the platform default.
A blocked response returns finishReason SAFETY with no content, and safetyRatings names the category and probability that tripped it. Any caller has to handle an empty candidate.
supportedModels: gemini reasoning models with thinkingMode google-budget or google-level
